rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's characteristic handwriting.

example.english: Your handwriting is recognizable at a glance.
example.traditional: 你嘅字跡一睇就知係你寫嘅。
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 zi6 zek3 jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 hai6 nei5 se2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the style or form of someone's handwriting rather than the written marks themselves.

example.english: Your handwriting style is beautiful; I know it is yours at a glance.
example.traditional: 你嘅字體好靚，一睇就知係你寫嘅。
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 zi6 tai2 hou2 leng3 jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 hai6 nei5 se2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for text produced by hand, especially when contrasting it with typed or printed text.

example.traditional: 呢張卡入面全部都係手寫字。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 kaat1 jap6 min6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 sau2 se2 zi6

rows.note: Use this for the activity of writing by hand when it is contrasted with typing or word-processing.

example.english: I prefer handwriting to typing on a computer.
example.traditional: 我鍾意寫字多過用電腦打字。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 se2 zi6 do1 gwo3 jung6 din6 nou5 daa2 zi6
